April 29, 2018 - By Peter Erickson

The institutional investor held 202,389 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.06 million, down from 225,796 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suffolk Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $175.92B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.19 $68.99. About 10.42 million shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 17.06% outperformed by 5.51% the S&P500.
